shared_elements: upright stone slab/monument with rounded top
carved relief on a single flat face
small anthropomorphic or figural forms in the upper zone
justification: Both are upright, round-topped stone monuments whose flat front face carries carved decoration organised with figural motifs above and a prominent circular disc, which is the most specific correspondence. Otherwise they differ profoundly: A is a pale, crisply incised slab dominated by dozens of tightly ruled horizontal register lines of small repeated signs, while B is a dark, heavily weathered, sculpturally modelled block with a few large deep-relief motifs and no linear text-like registers.
